enablement_js.overwrite_repeat: Requires File.option.lastExport (truthy), t.path, and lastExportNoOverwrite===false. File switch sets lastExportNoOverwrite=true if lastExport still present, disabling overwrite while leaving last format object.
enablement_js.export_with_previous_without_overwrite: exportLast(false) still Object.assign last options; overwrite forced false. If lastExport missing, uses _lastExport if any; if both missing, exports {overwrite:false} with no type — behavior then undefined. Menu disable for empty lastExport is native (unknown exact predicate).
enablement_js.per_document_vs_global: lastExport lives on File.option and TyWindowController (per window). Same-window file switch keeps lastExport, sets lastExportNoOverwrite. Format/options therefore follow the window's last successful dialog-accepted export, not a separate per-file store. Output overwrite path is blocked after switch until a new recordLastExport. loadExportOption merges current file/global typora-* settings on each export. lastSaveLocation is process-level File.option (global-ish) on Node; Mac native directory memory unknown.

save_panel.overwrite_true_and_path: Skip panel. If noWarningForExportOverwrite, return path. Else showWarningDialog Panel string '"Export and Overwrite with Previous" will overwrite file at %@, would you continue?' with checkbox. response!=0 => null (cancel). checkboxChecked => putSetting noWarningForExportOverwrite.

defaultPath_rules: If option.path set: if !lastExport OR lastExportNoOverwrite then dirname(path)+sep+suggestedName.ext else full option.path
Else if lastSaveLocation: that dir + suggested name
Else exportFolder==='same': current file folder + name
Else suggested name only (Mac may pass empty defaultPath via r flag)

commands_from_native_menu.established: ObjC actions exportWithPrevious: and exportAndOverwriteWithPrevious: on TyWindowController(Export). JS API they must drive is ClientCommand.exportLast(false|true). Bridge record channel export.recordLastExport.
commands_from_native_menu.not_established: Exact evaluateJavaScript / WK script text native uses to invoke exportLast is not in TypeMark as a native-injected string (no 'exportLast' in Typora Mach-O). Do not guess the eval payload.

proposed_minimal_independent_implementat.menu: Under File > Export, after format items: 'Export with Previous' and 'Export and Overwrite with Previous' (localize via same English keys). Do not copy Typora binaries.
proposed_minimal_independent_implementat.state: Per MarkdownDocument/window: lastExport {type, path, ...format options} and lastExportNoOverwrite. On successful save-panel OK (or overwrite confirm OK), set lastExport and lastExportNoOverwrite=false. On document replace/load in same window, if lastExport exists set lastExportNoOverwrite=true. Optional process-level lastSaveLocation for default dir.
proposed_minimal_independent_implementat.enable: Both items disabled when lastExport missing or type empty. Overwrite item also disabled when lastExportNoOverwrite or !path.
proposed_minimal_independent_implementat.commands: Independent native commands e.g. exportLast / exportLastOverwrite that reuse existing exportDocument(format) with stored type; replica should not send original ObjC selectors. Web: extend exportFormat or add exportLast payload {overwrite:boolean}.
proposed_minimal_independent_implementat.panel: Non-overwrite: NSSavePanel defaulting to rules above (prefer stored path dir+new name after switch; full last path only when overwrite allowed). Overwrite: no panel; confirm with same warning string unless user opted out (replica-owned defaults key, not Typora's container).
proposed_minimal_independent_implementat.update_rules: Update lastExport only after user confirms destination (panel OK or overwrite confirm), matching original record-after-dialog-ok even if later write fails. Panel cancel / warning cancel: no state change. Failure UI: keep lastExport.
proposed_minimal_independent_implementat.out_of_scope_here: ImageExport capture internals owned by another worker; reuse existing png export path only.
